mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (id, event_type, routing_key, subject, payload, created_at, failure_count, manual_retry_count) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventType}, #{routingKey}, #{subject}, #{payload}::jsonb, #{createdAt}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type, routing_key, subject, payload, created_at FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (subject) id, event_type, routing_key, subject, payload::text AS payload, created_at, next_attempt_at, quarantined_at FROM outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NULL ORDER BY subject, created_at, id ) head WHERE quarantined_at IS NULL AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= now()) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET published_at = #{publishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: UPDATE outbox_event SET failure_count = failure_count + 1, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_failed_at = now(), next_attempt_at = CASE failure_count WHEN 0 THEN now() + interval '1 minute' WHEN 1 THEN now() + interval '5 minutes' WHEN 2 THEN now() + interval '15 minutes' END, quarantined_at = CASE WHEN failure_count >= 3 THEN now() END WHERE id = #{id} AND published_at IS NULL RETURNING quarantined_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at < #{before}
